Grounding: every number in the report traces to a tool result, including 3349/669, 10270, 3708, 0.1022, 31, 1.35, -0.77, 5.0, 0.0, 1.5, 1.20, 0.36, 5.45 vs 35.0, 0.91, 2991 ms, 60 LIMIT orders, and the touch drifting from 9997/9998 to 9989/9990. None is invented.
